h1.en: Diesel Mixer Pump vs Diesel 40: 66 kW beside the Chute (gravity) article
h1.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机和柴油40有何不同：对照「Chute (gravity)」时，66 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: The diesel mixer and Diesel 40 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai that both mention a 4108 engine. Diesel 40 lists 66 kW, 26 m³/h and one distance pair, 120 m / 360 m, with no mixer motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity).
directAnswer.zh: 柴油搅拌泵和柴油40是河北品锦机械在邢台的机器，都提到 4108 发动机。柴油40标出 66 kW、26 m³/h 和一组距离 120 m / 360 m，没有搅拌电机。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity)。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity). The picture shows Chute (gravity). The diesel mixer and Diesel 40 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai that both mention a 4108 engine. Theoretical output: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 25 m³/h. Diesel 40 lists 26 m³/h. The same shown value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. Diesel 40 lists entries that Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump does not: Diesel engine power 4108 / 66 kW. Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 360 m. Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity)。画面是Chute (gravity)。柴油搅拌泵和柴油40是河北品锦机械在邢台的机器，都提到 4108 发动机。最大出口压力：柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 23 MPa；柴油40标出 25 MPa。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看柴油搅拌泵一体机请打开 /zh/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/，看柴油40请打开 /zh/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Diesel 40 lists 66 kW, 26 m³/h and one distance pair, 120 m / 360 m, with no mixer motor. Max. outlet pressure: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 23 MPa. Diesel 40 lists 25 MPa. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 柴油40标出 66 kW、26 m³/h 和一组距离 120 m / 360 m，没有搅拌电机。外形尺寸：柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm；柴油40标出 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。柴油搅拌泵一体机有、柴油40没有的行：柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m；系列说明 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: The diesel mixer lists 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, three stone-distance rows and the note 30 model with 400 mixer. 40/50 model with 500 mixer. Dimensions: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Diesel 40 lists 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Seeing 4108 on both pages does not remove the mixer series note from one of them. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 柴油搅拌泵标出 66–75 kW、25 m³/h、三行石子距离，以及说明：30 型配 400 搅拌机，40/50 型配 500 搅拌机。整机重量：柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 4200 kg；柴油40标出 2800 kg。柴油40有、柴油搅拌泵一体机没有的行：柴油机功率 4108 / 66 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 112。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: The mixer is not a pump-only trailer. Main unit weight: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 4200 kg. Diesel 40 lists 2800 kg. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists entries that Diesel 40 does not: Diesel engine 4108 / 66–75 kW. Stone capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m. 13 mm stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m. 24 mm stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m. Series note 30 model with 400 mixer. 40/50 model with 500 mixer. Open /en/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/ for Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump and /en/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 40.
body.zh: 理论输送量：柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 25 m³/h；柴油40标出 26 m³/h。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。两页都出现 4108，并不能取消其中一页的搅拌机系列说明。

question.en: Does Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump list the same theoretical output as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机和柴油40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 25 m³/h. Diesel 40 lists 26 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity).
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 25 m³/h。柴油40标出 26 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump list the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机和柴油40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 23 MPa. Diesel 40 lists 25 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity).
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 23 MPa。柴油40标出 25 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump list the same dimensions as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机和柴油40的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Diesel 40 lists 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity).
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油搅拌泵一体机标出 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm。柴油40标出 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is diesel engine missing on Diesel 40?
question.zh: 为什么柴油40没有柴油机？

answer.en: The Diesel 40 page does not list that label. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump lists 4108 / 66–75 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity).
answer.zh: 柴油40这一页没有标出这个标题。柴油搅拌泵一体机标出的是 4108 / 66–75 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chute_(gravity)画面里印出的数字。
